content.description: Filed by dr-w32-s7 (the ledger reclaim). Of the 76 landed-but-open rows, 52 were closed against named mergeCommits. These 24 were not, deliberately: each needs a judgement a merge cannot supply. The full per-row list with unmet criterion indices is committed at tooling/grip/ledger/w32-open-row-landed-partition-2026-08-09.md, section EXECUTION RECORD. GROUP A is 21 rows whose unmet criteria are the builder's own unfinished proofs - a live probe, a before/after paste, an ops action - which a landed PR does not evidence; dr-w8-s4-census-reaches-a-human demands PLATFORM_ADMIN_EMAILS on the serving control plane and it is still unset, and dr-w5-s4-agent-binary-reaches-the-fleet reads 4/8 with three live-proof criteria unstamped. GROUP B is 3 rows whose own merge criterion carries a command that was run against origin/main e913de82c881 and failed: dr-w26-s3 (grep -c 'Carried *bool' in internal/cloudclient/deliveries.go returns 0 where the criterion demands 1), dr-w26-s6 (git grep -c publish_clock origin/main is non-empty where the criterion demands nothing), dr-w26-s7 (the scoped runner_queue_len/build_slots grep still hits instance_site_deploy_controller.ex and router.ex where the criterion demands nothing). Do Group B first: those three are live contradictions between main and the ledger, and two of them are deletion claims that may be false. For each row either run the missing proof and stamp it, or reword the criterion to what is actually owed and say why. Do not bulk-close.
